name: a run of short claims, each its own flat colour
looks: A run of four short, blunt statements hard-cut one after another, each on its own full-bleed flat colour field (a bright accent, near-black, white, a striped hazard pattern), each statement two-tone with one word picked out in a dot-matrix weight. A diagonal strip along the bottom edge scrolls a longer continuous list of related short phrases throughout, never pausing.
build: DOM phrase swapped hard-cut on the beat, each card's background a different flat fill from a small accent palette; a thin diagonal marquee strip duplicated end-to-end scrolls left at a constant linear rate beneath the cards, independent of the card cuts.
sound: A dry hit on each card's cut, a very quiet continuous tick bed under the scrolling strip.
prompt: Deliver a short run of blunt, punchy claims as hard cuts, each one on its own full-bleed flat colour so the run itself feels like a drumbeat of colour changes, while a thin diagonal strip along one edge scrolls a longer list of related phrases continuously underneath, tying the whole run together as one live feed.
